EXECUTION ROADMAP
A 12-month plan with evidence gates
MONTHS 1-2
First value
Instrument the data path and run the accountant-invitation A/B test.
MONTHS 3-5
Useful recurrence
Read the first test, then test meaningful weekly cash reviews.
MONTHS 6-8
Packaging
Audit entitlements, then test the free/paid boundary if needed.
MONTHS 9-12
Distribution
Validate cross-business introductions and scale with retained revenue.
Proposed sequence: November 2026 to October 2027. Timing depends on feasibility.
